locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the physical logarithmic interval is [-log(lambda),log(lambda)]
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(y)*exp(-i*t*y) dy and Plancherel measure is dt/(2*pi)
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is included and translations at magnitude 2*log(lambda) vanish by zero extension
locked_conventions.inversion: multiplicatively Jf(u)=f(u^(-1)); in the additive logarithmic coordinate Jf(y)=f(-y)
locked_conventions.source_normalization: all-even prolate combinations use the source zero-Lebesgue-integral normalization, never unit normalization
locked_conventions.strictness: ell_H=c_minus, rho=g, or a zero Schur floor is a rejection, never a pass
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: p and dps label exact rational theorem-regression models, not physical prolate-Weil pilot matrices or an asymptotic schedule
locked_conventions.arithmetic: all component matrices, atom weights, exterior volumes, and reserves are exact reduced rationals; binary64 JSON numbers are forbidden

locked_formulas.exterior_leverage: E_(k+1)([W,a])=E_k(W)*kappa_H(a), with E_k the sum of k-column Gram determinants and E_0=1
locked_formulas.trimmed_mean: ell_H=inf{integral alpha*w*dmu_H: 0<=alpha<=1 and integral alpha*dmu_H=1}, dmu_H=kappa_H(t)*dt/(2*pi)
locked_formulas.stop_loss: sup_g(g-integral(g-w)_+*dmu_H)=ell_H; existence of g>0 with V_H(g)+c_minus<g is equivalent to ell_H>c_minus
locked_formulas.higher_moment: for the multiplier-only negative block, rho<=(tr R_HH^p)^(1/p)<=A_(p,H)^(1/p)+2*P_(p,H)^(1/p) for even p; an unabsorbed odd pole adds c_minus before comparison with g
locked_formulas.feature_trace: tau_H=tr R_HH=norm(P_H*Y^*)_HS^2=inf_Z norm(Y^*-WZ)_HS^2; rho<=tau_H, with tau_H=V_H for the multiplier-only block and tau_H=V_H+c_minus when the odd pole is an additional negative feature
locked_formulas.neumann_tail: after terms j=0,...,q the effective-load remainder is <=((rho/g)^(q+1)/(1-rho/g))*R_KK
locked_formulas.mobius_right_inverse: R_lambda*g(x)=sum_(n<=lambda/x)mu(n)*g(nx)/sqrt(nx), A_lambda*R_lambda*g=g, followed by an invisible central-hole correction to zero source integral
locked_formulas.prolate_common_eigensystem: for k_c(z)=sin(c*z)/(pi*z), (L_(c,x)-L_(c,y))*k_c(x-y)=0; the sinc concentration operator commutes with the simple complete Sturm prolate operator and injectivity identifies their common modes
locked_formulas.coframe_tail: T P_F T^*=R^(1/2)*(I-L_F)*R^(1/2), L_F=Z*(I-P_F)*Z^*, and full row rank is equivalent to norm(L_F)<1
